translations.idiomatic: The presiding banquet officials and all others rose and went to their stations; flowers were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 少頃，戴花畢，次引押宴官以下並釋褐貢士詣庭中望闕位立，謝花再拜，復升就坐，酒行、樂作，飲訖、食畢，樂止。

translations.literal: After a short while, when wearing the flowers was finished, next they led the presiding banquet officials and below and the newly robed presented scholars to the courtyard to stand facing the palace gate position; they thanked for the flowers and bowed twice; again they ascended and took seats; wine was served and music performed; drinking and eating were finished; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, once the flowers had been donned, the presiding banquet officials and newly robed presented scholars were led to the courtyard to stand facing the palace gate, thanked for the flowers, and bowed twice. They then ascended again and took their seats; wine was served and music performed until drinking and eating were finished and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 酒四行訖，退。

translations.literal: When wine had been served four times and finished, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After the fourth round of wine was complete, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 次日，預宴官及釋褐貢士入謝如常儀。

translations.literal: The next day, the banquet participants and newly robed presented scholars entered to give thanks according to the usual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, the banquet participants and newly robed presented scholars came to give thanks according to the usual protocol.

sentences.zh: 寧宗慶元五年五月，賜新及第進士曾從龍以下聞喜宴於禮部貢院，上賜七言四韻詩，秘書監楊王休以下繼和以進，自後每舉並如之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Qingyuan under Ningzong, the Hearing Joy Banquet was granted to newly passed jinshi including Zeng Conglong and below at the Ministry of Rites Examination Academy; the Emperor granted a seven-character quatrain poem; Supervising Secretary Yang Wangxiu and below successively composed matching poems and presented them; thereafter at every examination it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Qingyuan, Ningzong granted the Hearing Joy Banquet at the Ministry of Rites Examination Academy to the newly passed jinshi, beginning with Zeng Conglong. The Emperor bestowed a seven-character quatrain, and Supervising Secretary Yang Wangxiu and others successively composed matching poems and presented them. Thereafter, this was done at every examination.

sentences.zh: 幸秘書省。

translations.literal: Imperial visit to the Directorate of Archives.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial visits to the Directorate of Archives.

sentences.zh: 紹興十四年七月，新建秘書省成，秘書少監遊操等援宣和故事，請車駕臨幸，詔從之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourteenth year of Shaoxing, the newly built Directorate of Archives was completed; Vice Director of the Archives You Cao and others, citing the Xuanhe precedent, requested the imperial carriage to visit in person; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourteenth year of Shaoxing, the newly built Directorate of Archives was completed. Vice Director You Cao and others cited the Xuanhe precedent and requested an imperial visit; the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 二十七日，幸秘書省，至右文殿降輦，頒手詔曰：“蓋聞周建外史，掌三皇、五帝之書；

translations.literal: On the twenty-seventh day, he visited the Directorate of Archives; arriving at Youwen Hall he descended from the palanquin and issued a handwritten edict saying: "I have heard that Zhou established outer scribes to keep the books of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors;
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-seventh day, the Emperor visited the Directorate of Archives. Arriving at Youwen Hall, he descended from the palanquin and issued a handwritten edict: "I have heard that the Zhou established outer scribes to keep the books of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors;

sentences.zh: 漢選諸儒，定九流、《七略》之奏。

translations.literal: Han selected various Confucians and fixed the memorial on the Nine Schools and the "Seven Summaries."
translations.idiomatic: the Han selected various Confucian scholars and fixed the memorial on the Nine Schools and the "Seven Summaries."

sentences.zh: 文德之盛，後世推焉。

translations.literal: The flourishing of literary virtue—later ages praise it.
translations.idiomatic: The flourishing of literary virtue is praised by later ages.

sentences.zh: 仰惟祖宗建開冊府，凡累朝名世之士，由是以興，而一代致治之原，蓋出於此。

translations.literal: Looking up to how our forefathers established and opened the archive bureau, eminent men of successive reigns rose thereby, and the source of good governance for an age sprang from this.
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that our forefathers established this archive, from which eminent men of successive reigns rose, and that the source of an age's good governance lies here.

sentences.zh: 朕嘉興與學士大夫共宏斯道，乃一新史觀，新御榜題，肆從望幸之忱，以示右文之意。

translations.literal: I rejoice to promote learning together with scholar-officials to expand this Way; therefore I have newly renovated the archive hall and newly inscribed the imperial plaque, and freely fulfill the wish for an imperial visit to show the intent to honor literature.
translations.idiomatic: I rejoice to promote learning together with scholar-officials and to advance this Way. I have therefore renovated the archive hall and newly inscribed the imperial plaque, and I now fulfill the long-held wish for an imperial visit to show my intent to honor literature.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 士習為空言，而不為有用之學久矣。

translations.literal: Scholars' practice of empty words rather than useful learning has been long.
translations.idiomatic: For too long scholars have cultivated empty words rather than useful learning.

sentences.zh: 爾其勉修術業，益勵猷為，一德一心，以共赴亨嘉之會，用丕承我祖宗之大訓，顧不善歟！

translations.literal: You should earnestly cultivate your arts and professions, further encourage plans and actions, with one virtue and one heart, together to meet this prosperous and auspicious occasion, thereby greatly to inherit our forefathers' great instruction—is this not good!
translations.idiomatic: Earnestly cultivate your arts and professions, further your plans and deeds, and with united virtue and purpose together meet this prosperous and auspicious age, thereby greatly inheriting our forefathers' great teaching—surely this is good!

sentences.zh: ”遂陳累朝御書、御製、晉唐書畫、三代古器，次宣皇太子、宰臣以下觀訖，退。

translations.literal: "Then imperial writings and compositions of successive reigns, Jin and Tang calligraphy and painting, and antiquities of the Three Dynasties were displayed; next the Crown Prince, chief ministers, and below were summoned to view; when finished, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: "Imperial writings and compositions of successive reigns, Jin and Tang calligraphy and painting, and antiquities of the Three Dynasties were then displayed. The Crown Prince, chief ministers, and others were summoned to view them; when they had finished, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 遂賜宴於右文殿，酒五行，群臣再拜退。

translations.literal: Then a banquet was granted at Youwen Hall; wine was served five times; the ministers bowed twice and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: A banquet was then granted at Youwen Hall with five rounds of wine; the ministers bowed twice and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 車駕還內，賜少監遊操三品服、御書扇，餘官筆墨，館閣官各轉一官。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage returned within; Vice Director You Cao was granted third-rank dress and an imperial calligraphy fan; the remaining officials received brush and ink; each archives and institute official was promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage returned to the palace. Vice Director You Cao was granted third-rank dress and an imperial calligraphy fan; the other officials received brush and ink; and each archives and institute official was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 淳熙五年九月十三日，孝宗幸秘書省，如紹興十四年之儀，帝賦詩，群臣皆屬和。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the ninth month of the fifth year of Chunxi, Xiaozong visited the Directorate of Archives according to the fourteenth-year Shaoxing protocol; the Emperor composed a poem and all ministers matched it.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of the ninth month of the fifth year of Chunxi, Xiaozong visited the Directorate of Archives according to the Shaoxing fourteenth-year protocol. The Emperor composed a poem, and all the ministers composed matching verses.

sentences.zh: 進書儀。

translations.literal: Protocol for presenting books.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol for presenting books.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十年五月八日，進呈《中興聖統》，太常博士丁屢明言：“乞比附進呈玉牒行禮。

translations.literal: On the eighth day of the fifth month of the twentieth year of Shaoxing, "The Restoration Sacred Lineage" was presented; Doctor of the Grand Ceremonial Office Ding Lüming said: "I request that the rites follow those for presenting the jade register.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day of the fifth month of the twentieth year of Shaoxing, "The Restoration Sacred Lineage" was presented. Doctor of the Grand Ceremonial Office Ding Lüming said, "I request that the ceremony follow the protocol for presenting the jade register.

sentences.zh: ”二十四年，進呈《徽宗御集》，禮部言：“昨紹興十年，徽宗御製，擬以‘敷文’名閣，今乞權安奉於天章閣，續俟崇建。

translations.literal: "In the twenty-fourth year, "Collected Writings of Emperor Huizong" was presented; the Ministry of Rites said: "Previously in the tenth year of Shaoxing, Huizong's imperial compositions were proposed to name a pavilion 'Spreading Literature'; now I request they be provisionally enshrined at the Heavenly Writings Pavilion, to await later grand construction.
translations.idiomatic: "In the twenty-fourth year, "Collected Writings of Emperor Huizong" was presented. The Ministry of Rites said, "Previously in the tenth year of Shaoxing, Huizong's imperial compositions were proposed to name a pavilion 'Spreading Literature.' I now request that they be provisionally enshrined at the Heavenly Writings Pavilion, pending later grand construction.

sentences.zh: ”二十六年十月，進呈《太后回鑾事實》。

translations.literal: "In the tenth month of the twenty-sixth year, "True Record of the Empress Dowager's Return to the Capital" was presented.
translations.idiomatic: "In the tenth month of the twenty-sixth year, "True Record of the Empress Dowager's Return to the Capital" was presented.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月，宰臣沈該言：“玉牒所官陳康伯等先次編修太祖皇帝玉牒，自誕聖至即位，自建隆元年至開寶九年，通修一十七年開基玉牒，舊制以梅紅羅麵簽金字，今欲題曰《皇宋太祖皇帝玉牒》。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year, Chief Minister Shen Gai said: "Officials of the Jade Register Office Chen Kangbo and others first compiled the jade register of Emperor Taizu, from birth to accession, from the first year of Jianlong to the ninth year of Kaibao, totaling seventeen years of the founding jade register; the old system used plum-red silk with gold characters on the labels; now we wish to inscribe it "Imperial Song Jade Register of Emperor Taizu."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year, Chief Minister Shen Gai said, "Chen Kangbo and other officials of the Jade Register Office have first compiled the jade register of Emperor Taizu, from his birth to his accession and from the first year of Jianlong through the ninth year of Kaibao—a total of seventeen years of the founding jade register. Under the old system the labels used plum-red silk with gold characters; we now wish to inscribe it "Imperial Song Jade Register of Emperor Taizu."

sentences.zh: 又編修今上皇帝玉牒，自誕聖之後聖德祥瑞、建大元帥府事跡，至即帝位二十餘年，又自即位後編修至紹興二年，通修二十六年中興玉牒，今欲題曰《皇宋今上皇帝玉牒》。

translations.literal: They also compiled the jade register of the present Emperor, from after birth through sagely virtue and auspicious signs and the deeds of establishing the Grand Marshal's headquarters, to more than twenty years upon accession; also from after accession compiled through the second year of Shaoxing, totaling twenty-six years of the Restoration jade register; now we wish to inscribe it "Imperial Song Jade Register of the Present Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: They have also compiled the jade register of the present Emperor, from after his birth through his sagely virtue, auspicious signs, and the deeds of establishing the Grand Marshal's headquarters, to more than twenty years upon his accession, and from accession through the second year of Shaoxing—a total of twenty-six years of the Restoration jade register. We now wish to inscribe it "Imperial Song Jade Register of the Present Emperor."

sentences.zh: 宣祖、太祖、太宗、魏王下各宗《仙源類譜》、五世昭穆，今已修寫進本，乞擇日進呈。

translations.literal: For each lineage under Progenitor Xuan, Taizu, Taizong, and Prince Wei, the "Immortal Source Genealogy Compendium" and five generations of zhao-mu ranking have now been compiled and copied in presentation copies; I request a day be chosen for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: For each lineage descended from Progenitor Xuan, Taizu, Taizong, and Prince Wei, the "Immortal Source Genealogy Compendium" and five generations of zhao-mu ranking have now been compiled and copied for presentation. I request that a day be chosen for the ceremony.

sentences.zh: ”詔從其請。

translations.literal: "An edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: "An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 前期，儀鸞司、臨安府於玉牒殿上南向，設權安奉玉牒、類譜並《中興聖統》幄次；

translations.literal: In advance, the Ceremonial Guard Office and Lin'an Prefecture south of Jade Register Hall facing south set up provisional enshrinement canopies for the jade registers, genealogy compendia, and "The Restoration Sacred Lineage";
translations.idiomatic: In advance, the Ceremonial Guard Office and Lin'an Prefecture set up south of Jade Register Hall, facing south, provisional enshrinement canopies for the jade registers, genealogy compendia, and "The Restoration Sacred Lineage";

sentences.zh: 又至玉牒所向外，設騎從官及文武百官等侍班幕次；

translations.literal: also beyond the Jade Register Office outward, set up waiting-canopies for mounted escort officials and civil and military officials on attendance duty;
translations.idiomatic: and beyond the Jade Register Office they also set up waiting-canopies for mounted escort officials and civil and military officials on attendance duty;

sentences.zh: 又於景靈宮內外，設騎從官幕次。

translations.literal: also inside and outside Jingling Palace, set up canopies for mounted escort officials.
translations.idiomatic: and inside and outside Jingling Palace they set up canopies for mounted escort officials.

sentences.zh: 進呈前一日，俟朝退，玉牒所提領官、都大提舉、諸司官、承受官、玉牒所官等赴本所幕次宿衛。

translations.literal: On the day before presentation, after the court session ended, the supervising official, grand supervisor, various office officials, receiving officials, and Jade Register Office officials of the Jade Register Office went to the office canopy to stand night guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before the presentation, after court was dismissed, the supervising official, grand supervisor, various office officials, receiving officials, and other Jade Register Office officials went to the office canopy to stand night guard.

sentences.zh: 俟儀仗樂人等排立，御史台、閣門、太常寺分引玉牒所官詣玉牒殿下，北向立。

translations.literal: When the ceremonial guards and musicians were arrayed, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led Jade Register Office officials to below Jade Register Hall and they stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremonial guards and musicians had been arrayed, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led Jade Register Office officials to below Jade Register Hall, where they stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引提領官詣玉牒殿下，北向立。

translations.literal: The protocol officer led the supervising official to below Jade Register Hall and he stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer led the supervising official to below Jade Register Hall, where he stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 禮直官揖、躬、拜，提領官拜，在位官皆再拜訖。

translations.literal: The protocol officer bowed with clasped hands, inclined his body, and bowed; the supervising official bowed; all officials in attendance all bowed twice; finished.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer bowed with clasped hands, inclined his body, and bowed; the supervising official bowed; and all officials present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 次引提領官詣香案前，搢笏，三上香，執笏退，復位，皆再拜訖，班退，歸幕次宿衛。

translations.literal: Next they led the supervising official to before the incense table; he inserted his tablet, offered incense three times, withdrew holding his tablet, returned to position; all bowed twice; finished; the formation withdrew and returned to the canopy for night guard.
translations.idiomatic: Next the supervising official was led to the incense table. He inserted his tablet, offered incense three times, withdrew holding his tablet, and returned to position; all bowed twice. The formation withdrew and returned to the canopy for night guard.

sentences.zh: 儀仗樂人作樂，晝夜更互排立。

translations.literal: The ceremonial guards and musicians performed music and were arrayed in alternating shifts day and night.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial guards and musicians performed music and stood guard in alternating shifts day and night.

sentences.zh: 其日五更，御史台、閣門、太常寺分引提領官、宰執、使相、侍從、台諫、兩省官、知閣、禮官、南班宗室詣玉牒殿，北向立。

translations.literal: At the fifth watch that day, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led the supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, and southern-branch imperial clansmen to Jade Register Hall and they stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth watch that day, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led the supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, and southern-branch imperial clansmen to Jade Register Hall, where they stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 禮直官揖、躬、拜，提領官拜，在位官皆再拜訖。

translations.literal: The protocol officer bowed with clasped hands, inclined his body, and bowed; the supervising official bowed; all officials in attendance all bowed twice; finished.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer bowed with clasped hands, inclined his body, and bowed; the supervising official bowed; and all officials present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 次引提領官詣玉牒、類譜香案前，搢笏，三上香，執笏，退，復位。

translations.literal: Next they led the supervising official to before the incense table for the jade registers and genealogy compendia; he inserted his tablet, offered incense three times, withdrew holding his tablet, and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: Next the supervising official was led to the incense table for the jade registers and genealogy compendia. He inserted his tablet, offered incense three times, withdrew holding his tablet, and returned to position.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引提領官詣幄前，西向立。

translations.literal: The protocol officer led the supervising official to before the canopy and he stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer led the supervising official to before the canopy, where he stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 次騎從官分左右乘馬，俟玉牒所率輦官奉擎玉牒、類譜，腰輿進行，樂人作樂，儀衛、儀仗迎引。

translations.literal: Next mounted escort officials divided left and right and mounted horses, awaiting Jade Register Office palanquin officers bearing the jade registers and genealogy compendia; sedan chairs proceeded; musicians performed music; ceremonial guards and ceremonial escorts welcomed and led them.
translations.idiomatic: Next the mounted escort officials divided left and right and mounted their horses, awaiting the Jade Register Office palanquin officers bearing the jade registers and genealogy compendia. The sedan chairs proceeded, musicians performed, and ceremonial guards and escorts welcomed and led them.

sentences.zh: 次引提領官、宰執、使相、侍從、台諫、兩省官、知閣、禮官、南班宗室騎從，至和寧門下馬，執笏步從玉牒、類譜至垂拱殿門外幄次，步從官權歸幕次，樂止。

translations.literal: Next they led the supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, and southern-branch imperial clansmen in mounted escort; at Hening Gate they dismounted, holding tablets walked escorting the jade registers and genealogy compendia to the canopy outside Chuigong Hall gate; walking escort officials temporarily returned to the waiting-canopy; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Next the supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, and southern-branch imperial clansmen rode in escort. At Hening Gate they dismounted and, holding their tablets, walked escorting the jade registers and genealogy compendia to the canopy outside Chuigong Hall gate. The walking escort officials temporarily returned to the waiting-canopy, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 儀衛、樂人等並於幄次前排立，俟進呈玉牒、類譜，並如閣門儀訖。

translations.literal: Ceremonial guards and musicians all arrayed before the canopies, awaiting presentation of the jade registers and genealogy compendia, all according to Gate Command protocol; finished.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial guards and musicians all arrayed before the canopies, awaiting the presentation of the jade registers and genealogy compendia, all according to Gate Command protocol.

sentences.zh: 俟玉牒、類譜出殿門，御史台、閣門、太常寺分引提領官、宰執、使相、侍從、台諫、兩省官、知閣、禮官、南班宗室分左右執笏步從，儀衛樂人前引，迎奉出皇城北宮門，步從等官上馬騎從，至和寧門外。

translations.literal: When the jade registers and genealogy compendia exited the hall gate, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led the supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, and southern-branch imperial clansmen to divide left and right holding tablets walking in escort; ceremonial guards and musicians led before, welcoming and escorting them out the northern palace gate of the Imperial City; walking escort officials mounted horses and rode in escort to outside Hening Gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the jade registers and genealogy compendia exited the hall gate, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led the supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, and southern-branch imperial clansmen to divide left and right, holding their tablets and walking in escort. Ceremonial guards and musicians led the way, welcoming and escorting them out the northern palace gate of the Imperial City. The walking escort officials mounted their horses and rode in escort to outside Hening Gate.

sentences.zh: 前引將至玉牒所，御史台、閣門、太常寺分引文武百官於玉牒所門內殿門外立班，內文臣厘務通直郎以上及承務郎見任寺監主簿執事官以上，武臣修武郎以上，迎拜訖。

translations.literal: Leading forward as they were about to reach the Jade Register Office, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led civil and military officials to form ranks inside the Jade Register Office gate and outside the hall gate; within, civil officials of Commissioner for Drafting and above on active duty and incumbent Registrar and above serving as executive officials in directorates and supervisorates; military officials of Master-at-Arms and above; they greeted and bowed; finished.
translations.idiomatic: As they approached the Jade Register Office, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led civil and military officials to form ranks inside the Jade Register Office gate and outside the hall gate—including civil officials of Commissioner for Drafting and above on active duty and incumbent executive officials of Registrar rank and above in directorates and supervisorates, and military officials of Master-at-Arms and above—who greeted and bowed.

sentences.zh: 如值雨，地下沾濕，迎拜官吏不迎拜。

translations.literal: If it rained, the ground being wet, the greeting and bowing officials did not greet and bow.
translations.idiomatic: If it was raining and the ground was wet, the officials who would have greeted and bowed did not do so.

sentences.zh: 騎從官至玉牒所，並下馬執笏步從，詣玉牒殿下，分東西相向立。

translations.literal: Mounted escort officials arriving at the Jade Register Office all dismounted, holding tablets walked in escort, proceeded to below Jade Register Hall, divided east and west facing each other and stood.
translations.idiomatic: When the mounted escort officials arrived at the Jade Register Office, they all dismounted and, holding their tablets, walked in escort to below Jade Register Hall, where they divided east and west and stood facing each other.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引提領官詣玉牒、類譜幄前，西向立定。

translations.literal: The protocol officer led the supervising official to before the canopy for the jade registers and genealogy compendia and he stood facing west, fixed in position.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer led the supervising official to before the canopy for the jade registers and genealogy compendia, where he stood facing west in fixed position.

sentences.zh: 俟玉牒所率輦官奉擎玉牒、類譜入幄，儀仗、儀衛、輦官、樂人更互排立。

translations.literal: When Jade Register Office palanquin officers bearing the jade registers and genealogy compendia entered the canopy, ceremonial escorts, ceremonial guards, palanquin officers, and musicians were arrayed in alternating shifts.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jade Register Office palanquin officers bearing the jade registers and genealogy compendia entered the canopy, the ceremonial escorts, guards, palanquin officers, and musicians were arrayed in alternating shifts.

sentences.zh: 提領官、宰執、使相、侍從、台諫、兩省官、知閣、禮官、南班宗室及玉牒所官、分官赴景靈宮，迎奉《皇帝中興聖統》赴玉牒殿，同時安奉。

translations.literal: The supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, southern-branch imperial clansmen, and Jade Register Office officials and subordinate officials went to Jingling Palace, welcomed and escorted "The Emperor's Restoration Sacred Lineage" to Jade Register Hall, and enshrined them simultaneously.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising official, chief ministers, envoys with emblems, close attendants, censorial remonstrators, officials of the two Secretariat offices, Gate Command officials, ritual officials, southern-branch imperial clansmen, and Jade Register Office officials and subordinate officials went to Jingling Palace, welcomed and escorted "The Emperor's Restoration Sacred Lineage" to Jade Register Hall, and enshrined them simultaneously.

sentences.zh: 俟安奉時將至，設香案畢，次御史台、閣門、太常寺分引文武百官詣玉牒殿下，並北向立班定。

translations.literal: When the time of enshrinement was about to arrive, after the incense table was set up and finished, next the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led civil and military officials to below Jade Register Hall; all facing north they formed ranks and fixed position.
translations.idiomatic: When the time of enshrinement was about to arrive and the incense table had been set up, the Censorate, Gate Command, and Grand Ceremonial Office separately led civil and military officials to below Jade Register Hall, where they all formed ranks facing north.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引提領官詣幄前西立，俟日官報時及。

translations.literal: The protocol officer led the supervising official to stand west of the canopy, awaiting the time official to report that the hour had arrived.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer led the supervising official to stand west of the canopy, awaiting the time official's report that the hour had arrived.

sentences.zh: 次玉牒所安奉玉牒、類譜訖。

translations.literal: Next the Jade Register Office enshrined the jade registers and genealogy compendia; finished.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Jade Register Office enshrined the jade registers and genealogy compendia.

sentences.zh: 次引提領官復位，北向立定。

translations.literal: Next they led the supervising official back to position; facing north he stood fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Next the supervising official was led back to position and stood facing north in fixed position.

sentences.zh: 禮直官揖、躬、拜，提領官拜，在位官皆再拜訖。

translations.literal: The protocol officer bowed with clasped hands, inclined his body, and bowed; the supervising official bowed; all officials in attendance all bowed twice; finished.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer bowed with clasped hands, inclined his body, and bowed; the supervising official bowed; and all officials present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引提領官詣香案前，搢笏，三上香，執笏退，復位立定，在位皆再拜訖，退。

translations.literal: The protocol officer led the supervising official to before the incense table; he inserted his tablet, offered incense three times, withdrew holding his tablet, returned to position and stood fixed; all in attendance all bowed twice; finished; they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer led the supervising official to the incense table. He inserted his tablet, offered incense three times, withdrew holding his tablet, and returned to fixed position; all present bowed twice, then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 儀衛、樂人等以次退。

translations.literal: Ceremonial guards, musicians, and others withdrew in order.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial guards, musicians, and others withdrew in order.

sentences.zh: 自是，凡進書並仿此，惟進太上皇聖政，則有詣德壽宮之儀。

translations.literal: From this point, all book presentations followed this model; only when presenting the Retired Emperor's Sacred Policies was there protocol for going to Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: From this point on, all book presentations followed this model; only when presenting the Retired Emperor's Sacred Policies was there a separate protocol for going to Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 淳祐五年二月十二日，進孝宗、光宗兩朝御集、《寧宗實錄》及《理宗玉牒日曆》。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day of the second month of the fifth year of Chunyou, the collected writings of the Xiaozong and Guangzong reigns, "Veritable Record of Ningzong," and "Jade Register and Daily Calendar of Lizong" were presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the second month of the fifth year of Chunyou, the collected writings of the Xiaozong and Guangzong reigns, "Veritable Record of Ningzong," and "Jade Register and Daily Calendar of Lizong" were presented.

sentences.zh: 其日，皇帝御垂拱殿，提舉官、禮儀使、宗室、使相、宰執以下，赴實錄院、右文殿、玉牒所、經武閣並行燒香禮畢，奉迎諸書至和寧門，步導至垂拱殿，以俟班齊，各隨腰輿入殿下，東西向立。

translations.literal: That day, the Emperor presided at Chuigong Hall; supervising officials, ritual commissioners, imperial clansmen, envoys with emblems, chief ministers, and below went to the Veritable Records Academy, Youwen Hall, Jade Register Office, and Military Essentials Pavilion and all performed incense-offering rites; when finished, they welcomed and escorted the various books to Hening Gate, walked leading them to Chuigong Hall, awaiting the formations to be complete; each followed the sedan chairs into below the hall and stood facing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor presided at Chuigong Hall. Supervising officials, ritual commissioners, imperial clansmen, envoys with emblems, chief ministers, and others went to the Veritable Records Academy, Youwen Hall, Jade Register Office, and Military Essentials Pavilion and performed incense offerings. When finished, they welcomed and escorted the various books to Hening Gate and walked leading them to Chuigong Hall. Awaiting the formations to be complete, each followed the sedan chairs into below the hall and stood facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服靴袍出宮，殿下鳴鞭，禁衛、諸班直、親從等並入內省執骨朵使臣，國史實錄院、日曆所、編修經武要略所、玉牒所點檢文字以下並腰輿下人，並迎駕，自讚常起居。

translations.literal: The Emperor in boot-robes came out from the palace; below the hall the whip was sounded; palace guards, various duty shifts, close attendants, and inner-palace mace-bearing envoys, and text inspectors and below of the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office and sedan-chair bearers below all welcomed the imperial progress; the announcer himself praised the usual greeting.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor came out from the palace in boot-robes. Below the hall the whip was sounded. Palace guards, various duty shifts, close attendants, inner-palace mace-bearing envoys, text inspectors and below from the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office, and the sedan-chair bearers all welcomed the imperial progress as the announcer praised the usual greeting.

sentences.zh: （內擎腰輿人不拜，止應喏。）〉

translations.literal: (Those within bearing sedan chairs did not bow, only responded yes.)
translations.idiomatic: (Those bearing sedan chairs within did not bow, only responded yes.)

sentences.zh: 皇帝即御坐。

translations.literal: The Emperor then took the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then took the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 先知閣門官以下，各班起居如常儀。

translations.literal: First Gate Command officials and below; each formation performed greetings according to the usual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: First the Gate Command officials and others; each formation performed greetings according to the usual protocol.

sentences.zh: 次入內官下殿，各取合進呈書匣升殿，於殿上東壁各置案上，以南為上。

translations.literal: Next inner-palace officials descended the hall; each took the appropriate presentation book case and ascended the hall; on the east wall of the hall each placed it on a table, with south as superior.
translations.idiomatic: Next the inner-palace officials descended the hall, each took the appropriate presentation book case and ascended the hall, and on the east wall of the hall placed each on a table, with south as the superior position.

sentences.zh: 知閣門官二員，自御坐前導皇帝起詣三朝諸書香案前褥位，東向立。

translations.literal: Two Gate Command officials, from before the imperial seat guided the Emperor rising to go to the cushion position before the incense table for the books of the three reigns; facing east he stood.
translations.idiomatic: Two Gate Command officials guided the Emperor from before the imperial seat to the cushion before the incense table for the books of the three reigns, where he stood facing east.

sentences.zh: 閣門提點奏請上香，三上香訖，又奏請皇帝再拜訖，知閣門官前導皇帝復歸御坐。

translations.literal: The Gate Command inspector reported requesting incense offering; three incense offerings finished; again reported requesting the Emperor to bow twice; finished; Gate Command officials before guided the Emperor back to the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Command inspector reported a request to offer incense; after three offerings of incense, he again reported a request for the Emperor to bow twice. Gate Command officials then guided the Emperor back to the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 知閣門官歸東朵殿上侍立，儀鑾司徹香案、拜褥，降束朵殿。

translations.literal: Gate Command officials returned to the east hall to attend standing; the Ceremonial Guard Office removed the incense table and bowing cushion and lowered the east hall screen.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Command officials returned to the east hall to attend standing. The Ceremonial Guard Office removed the incense table and bowing cushion and lowered the east hall screen.

sentences.zh: 次舍人請國史實錄院以下提舉官、禮儀使、宰執並進讀官升殿，於御坐東面西立。

translations.literal: Next the usher requested supervising officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy and below, ritual commissioners, chief ministers, and presentation-reading officials to ascend the hall; east of the imperial seat facing west they stood.
translations.idiomatic: Next the usher requested the supervising officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy and below, the ritual commissioners, chief ministers, and presentation-reading officials to ascend the hall, where they stood east of the imperial seat facing west.

sentences.zh: （國史實錄院、國史日曆所、編修經武要略所、玉牒所官，殿下依舊立。）〉

translations.literal: (Officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy, National History Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office, below the hall still stood as before.)
translations.idiomatic: (Officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy, National History Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office remained standing below the hall as before.)

sentences.zh: 俟入內官進御案，《孝宗御集》提舉官並進讀御集官稍前立，分進讀御集官於御前過，西壁麵東立。

translations.literal: Awaiting inner-palace officials to bring the imperial table; supervising officials of "Collected Writings of Xiaozong" and presentation-reading collected-writings officials stepped slightly forward and stood; they divided presentation-reading collected-writings officials to pass before the imperial seat; on the west wall facing east they stood.
translations.idiomatic: When the inner-palace officials brought the imperial table, the supervising officials of "Collected Writings of Xiaozong" and the presentation-reading officials stepped slightly forward and stood. The presentation-reading officials were divided to pass before the imperial seat and stood on the west wall facing east.

sentences.zh: 御集提舉諸司官於《孝宗御集》匣前，搢笏、啟封、開鑰訖，出笏，歸侍立位。

translations.literal: Collected-writings supervising various office officials at the case of "Collected Writings of Xiaozong," inserted tablets, unsealed, opened the lock; finished; withdrew tablets; returned to attendant standing positions.
translations.idiomatic: The collected-writings supervising officials at the case of "Collected Writings of Xiaozong" inserted their tablets, unsealed it, and opened the lock; when finished, they withdrew their tablets and returned to their attendant standing positions.

sentences.zh: 御集承受官搢笏，於御集匣內取冊，轉授提舉官搢笏接訖，承受出笏，提舉官奉冊置御案上，出笏。

translations.literal: The collected-writings receiving official inserted his tablet, from within the collected-writings case took the volume, turned and handed it to the supervising official who inserted his tablet and received it; finished; the receiving official withdrew his tablet; the supervising official held the volume and placed it on the imperial table; withdrew his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The collected-writings receiving official inserted his tablet, took the volume from within the case, and handed it to the supervising official, who inserted his tablet and received it. The receiving official withdrew his tablet; the supervising official held the volume, placed it on the imperial table, and withdrew his tablet.

sentences.zh: 皇帝起前立，提舉諸司官、承受官分東西相向立，並搢笏揭冊訖，各出笏。

translations.literal: The Emperor rose and stood before; supervising various office officials and receiving officials divided east and west facing each other and stood; all inserted tablets and lifted the volume; finished; each withdrew his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rose and stood before them. The supervising officials and receiving officials divided east and west and stood facing each other; all inserted their tablets and lifted the volume; when finished, each withdrew his tablet.

sentences.zh: 進讀御集官搢笏稍前，取篦子指讀，

translations.literal: The presentation-reading collected-writings official inserted his tablet and stepped slightly forward, took the pointer and read aloud,
translations.idiomatic: The presentation-reading official inserted his tablet, stepped slightly forward, took the pointer, and read aloud,

sentences.zh: （逐版揭冊指讀，並如上儀。

translations.literal: (For each leaf, lifting the volume and pointing while reading, all as above protocol.
translations.idiomatic: (For each leaf, lifting the volume and pointing while reading, all as in the protocol above.

sentences.zh: 俟進讀畢，皇帝復坐，進讀御集官置篦子於御案上，出笏，卻於御前東壁麵西立以俟。

translations.literal: When reading was finished, the Emperor sat again; the presentation-reading collected-writings official placed the pointer on the imperial table, withdrew his tablet, and returned to stand facing west on the east wall before the imperial seat to await.
translations.idiomatic: When the reading was finished, the Emperor sat again. The presentation-reading official placed the pointer on the imperial table, withdrew his tablet, and returned to stand facing west on the east wall before the imperial seat to await.

sentences.zh: 提舉官搢笏、收冊，復授承受官搢笏接訖，提舉官出笏，稍後立。）

translations.literal: The supervising official inserted his tablet, collected the volume, and again handed it to the receiving official who inserted his tablet and received it; finished; the supervising official withdrew his tablet and stood slightly back.)
translations.idiomatic: The supervising official inserted his tablet, collected the volume, and handed it again to the receiving official, who inserted his tablet and received it. The supervising official withdrew his tablet and stood slightly back.)

sentences.zh: 承受官奉冊入匣訖，出笏，提舉諸司官搢笏、鎖匣訖，出笏，歸侍立位。

translations.literal: The receiving official held the volume into the case; finished; withdrew his tablet; supervising various office officials inserted tablets, locked the case; finished; withdrew tablets; returned to attendant standing positions.
translations.idiomatic: The receiving official placed the volume into the case and withdrew his tablet. The supervising officials inserted their tablets, locked the case, withdrew their tablets, and returned to their attendant standing positions.

sentences.zh: 次讀《光宗御集》、《寧宗實錄》、《光宗經武要略》，並同上儀。

translations.literal: Next they read "Collected Writings of Guangzong," "Veritable Record of Ningzong," and "Guangzong Military Essentials," all following the same protocol above.
translations.idiomatic: Next they read "Collected Writings of Guangzong," "Veritable Record of Ningzong," and "Guangzong Military Essentials," all following the same protocol.

sentences.zh: 次玉牒提舉官並進讀玉牒官稍前立，分進讀玉牒官於御前過，西壁麵東立。

translations.literal: Next jade-register supervising officials and presentation-reading jade-register officials stepped slightly forward and stood; they divided presentation-reading jade-register officials to pass before the imperial seat; on the west wall facing east they stood.
translations.idiomatic: Next the jade-register supervising officials and presentation-reading officials stepped slightly forward and stood. The presentation-reading officials were divided to pass before the imperial seat and stood on the west wall facing east.

sentences.zh: 玉牒提舉諸司官於玉牒匣前搢笏、啟封鑰訖，出笏，歸侍立位。

translations.literal: Jade-register supervising various office officials at the jade-register case front inserted tablets, unsealed the lock; finished; withdrew tablets; returned to attendant standing positions.
translations.idiomatic: The jade-register supervising officials at the jade-register case inserted their tablets, unsealed the lock, withdrew their tablets, and returned to their attendant standing positions.

sentences.zh: 玉牒承受官搢笏取冊，授提舉官置御案上，進讀亦如前儀，讀畢鎖匣，出笏，歸侍立位。

translations.literal: The jade-register receiving official inserted his tablet, took the volume, handed it to the supervising official who placed it on the imperial table; presentation-reading also as before protocol; when reading finished locked the case; withdrew tablet; returned to attendant standing position.
translations.idiomatic: The jade-register receiving official inserted his tablet, took the volume, and handed it to the supervising official, who placed it on the imperial table. The reading followed the same protocol as before; when reading was finished they locked the case, withdrew their tablets, and returned to their attendant standing positions.

sentences.zh: 次日曆提舉官並進讀日曆官啟封鑰，進讀亦同。

translations.literal: Next daily-calendar supervising officials and presentation-reading daily-calendar officials unsealed the lock; presentation-reading also the same.
translations.idiomatic: Next the daily-calendar supervising officials and presentation-reading officials unsealed the lock; the reading likewise followed the same protocol.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，入內官徹案，）

translations.literal: When all were finished, inner-palace officials removed the tables,)
translations.idiomatic: When all were finished, the inner-palace officials removed the tables.)

sentences.zh: 承受官奉冊入匣訖，出笏，提舉諸司官搢笏、鑰匣訖，出笏，歸侍立位。

translations.literal: The receiving official held the volume into the case; finished; withdrew his tablet; supervising various office officials inserted tablets, locked the case with the key; finished; withdrew tablets; returned to attendant standing positions.
translations.idiomatic: The receiving official placed the volume into the case and withdrew his tablet. The supervising officials inserted their tablets, locked the case with the key, withdrew their tablets, and returned to their attendant standing positions.

sentences.zh: 儀鸞司徹卓子，降束朵殿。

translations.literal: The Ceremonial Guard Office removed the tables and lowered the east hall screen.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonial Guard Office removed the tables and lowered the east hall screen.

sentences.zh: 奉書匣下殿，各置腰輿上。

translations.literal: They held the book cases down the hall; each placed them on sedan chairs.
translations.idiomatic: They carried the book cases down from the hall and placed each on a sedan chair.

sentences.zh: 國史實錄院、日曆所、編修經武要略所、玉牒所提舉官，禮儀使，宰執並降東階下殿，東壁麵西立。

translations.literal: Supervising officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office, ritual commissioners, and chief ministers all descended the east steps down the hall; on the east wall facing west they stood.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office, the ritual commissioners, and chief ministers all descended the east steps and stood on the east wall facing west.

sentences.zh: 舍人引各官及禮儀使一班當殿麵北立定，引各直身出班、斂身稱謝訖，歸位立，揖，躬身讚拜，兩拜訖。

translations.literal: The usher led each official and the ritual commissioner in one formation before the hall facing north and fixed position; led each to straighten his body, leave formation, and with constrained body express thanks; finished; returned to position and stood; bowed with clasped hands, inclined body; the announcer praised the bow; two bows finished.
translations.idiomatic: The usher led each official and the ritual commissioner in one formation before the hall facing north. He led each to straighten his body, leave formation, and with constrained body express thanks, then return to position. They bowed with clasped hands and inclined their bodies as the announcer praised the bow; they bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 讚各祗候直身立宣答，御藥下殿宣答，提舉官、禮儀使並斂身聽宣答訖，）

translations.literal: The announcer praised each attendant to straighten his body and stand; announced the reply; the imperial medicine official descended the hall and announced the reply; supervising officials and ritual commissioners all with constrained body listened to the announced reply; finished,)
translations.idiomatic: The announcer praised each attendant to stand straight; the imperial reply was announced. The imperial medicine official descended the hall and announced the reply; the supervising officials and ritual commissioners all listened with constrained body,)

sentences.zh: 御藥升殿。

translations.literal: The imperial medicine official ascended the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial medicine official ascended the hall.

sentences.zh: 揖，躬身讚拜，兩拜訖。

translations.literal: They bowed with clasped hands, inclined body; the announcer praised the bow; two bows finished.
translations.idiomatic: They bowed with clasped hands and inclined their bodies as the announcer praised the bow; they bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 讚各祗候直身立，舍人引赴東壁麵西立。

translations.literal: The announcer praised each attendant to straighten his body and stand; the usher led them to the east wall facing west to stand.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer praised each attendant to stand straight; the usher led them to the east wall, where they stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 次引國史實錄院、日曆所、編修經武要略所、玉牒所官一班首直身出班、斂身稱謝訖，歸位立，揖，躬身讚拜，兩拜訖，讚各祗候直身立。

translations.literal: Next they led officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office; the rank leader of one formation straightened his body, left formation, and with constrained body expressed thanks; finished; returned to position and stood; bowed with clasped hands, inclined body; the announcer praised the bow; two bows finished; the announcer praised each attendant to straighten his body and stand.
translations.idiomatic: Next the officials of the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office were led forward. The rank leader of one formation straightened his body, left formation, and with constrained body expressed thanks, then returned to position. They bowed with clasped hands and inclined their bodies as the announcer praised the bow; they bowed twice, and the announcer praised each attendant to stand straight.

sentences.zh: 如傳旨謝恩，知閣門官承旨訖，於折檻東面西立，傳與舍人承旨訖，再揖，躬身讚謝恩拜，兩拜訖，讚各祗候直身立。）

translations.literal: If transmitting a decree of thanks for grace, the Gate Command official received the decree; finished; at the folding railing east facing west stood; transmitted it to the usher who received the decree; finished; again bowed with clasped hands, inclined body; the announcer praised the thanks-for-grace bow; two bows finished; the announcer praised each attendant to straighten his body and stand.)
translations.idiomatic: If a decree of thanks for grace was transmitted, the Gate Command official received the decree and stood east of the folding railing facing west, then transmitted it to the usher, who received it. They again bowed with clasped hands and inclined their bodies as the announcer praised the thanks-for-grace bow; they bowed twice, and the announcer praised each attendant to stand straight.)

sentences.zh: 不該賜茶官先退。

translations.literal: Officials not entitled to granted tea withdrew first.
translations.idiomatic: Officials not entitled to granted tea withdrew first.

sentences.zh: 次引國史實錄院、日曆所、編修經武要略所、玉牒所提舉諸司官並承受官以下一班當殿麵北立定，揖，躬身讚謝恩拜，兩拜訖，讚各祗候直身立，各歸位立。

translations.literal: Next they led supervising various office officials and receiving officials and below of the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office in one formation before the hall facing north and fixed position; bowed with clasped hands, inclined body; the announcer praised the thanks-for-grace bow; two bows finished; the announcer praised each attendant to straighten his body and stand; each returned to position and stood.
translations.idiomatic: Next the supervising officials and receiving officials and below from the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office were led in one formation before the hall facing north. They bowed with clasped hands and inclined their bodies as the announcer praised the thanks-for-grace bow; they bowed twice, the announcer praised each attendant to stand straight, and each returned to position.

sentences.zh: 次引國史實錄院、日曆所、編修經武要略所、玉牒所點檢文字以下一班當殿麵北立定，揖，躬身，讚謝恩拜，兩拜訖，讚各祗候直身立，各歸位立。

translations.literal: Next they led text inspectors and below of the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office in one formation before the hall facing north and fixed position; bowed with clasped hands, inclined body; the announcer praised the thanks-for-grace bow; two bows finished; the announcer praised each attendant to straighten his body and stand; each returned to position and stood.
translations.idiomatic: Next the text inspectors and below from the National History Veritable Records Academy, Daily Calendar Office, Compilation Office for Military Essentials, and Jade Register Office were led in one formation before the hall facing north. They bowed with clasped hands and inclined their bodies as the announcer praised the thanks-for-grace bow; they bowed twice, the announcer praised each attendant to stand straight, and each returned to position.

sentences.zh: 傳旨宣坐賜茶訖，舍人奏閣門無公事，皇帝起還宮，百官導送，奏安兩朝《御集》、《實錄》於天章閣，《經武要略》於經武閣、《玉牒》於玉牒所、《日曆》於秘閣如儀。

translations.literal: A decree was transmitted ordering them to be seated; when granted tea was finished, the usher reported that the Gate Command had no official business; the Emperor rose and returned to the palace; the hundred officials escorted him; they reported installing the two reigns' "Collected Imperial Writings" and "Veritable Records" at the Heavenly Writings Pavilion, "Military Essentials" at the Military Essentials Pavilion, the "Jade Register" at the Jade Register Office, and the "Daily Calendar" at the Secret Pavilion according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: After a decree ordered those present to be seated and granted tea was finished, the usher reported that the Gate Command had no further business. The Emperor rose and returned to the palace as the hundred officials escorted him. The two reigns' "Collected Imperial Writings" and "Veritable Records" were installed at the Heavenly Writings Pavilion, "Military Essentials" at the Military Essentials Pavilion, the "Jade Register" at the Jade Register Office, and the "Daily Calendar" at the Secret Pavilion, all according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 大謝之禮，廢於五季，太宗始命有司草定儀注。

translations.literal: The rite of Great Thanksgiving was abandoned in the Five Dynasties period; Taizong first ordered the relevant offices to draft protocol regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The rite of Great Thanksgiving had been abandoned during the Five Dynasties; Taizong was the first to order the relevant offices to draft its protocol.

sentences.zh: 其群臣朝謁如元會。

translations.literal: The ministers' court audience was as at the 〈元會 New Year's assembly〉.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers' court audience followed the same protocol as the New Year's assembly.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，有司言“請賜王、公以下射”，侍中稱制可。

translations.literal: When wine had been served three times, the relevant office said, "We request that princes, dukes, and below be granted to shoot"; the Palace Secretariat Chief announced the imperial assent, "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: After the third round of wine, the relevant office said, "We request that princes, dukes, and those below them be granted to shoot." The Palace Secretariat Chief announced the imperial assent: "Approved."

sentences.zh: 皇帝改服武弁，布七埒於殿下，王、公以次射，開樂縣東西廂，設熊虎等侯。

translations.literal: The Emperor changed into the military cap, laid out seven butts below the hall; princes and dukes shot in order; the eastern and western wings of the music registers were opened; bear, tiger, and other targets were set up.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor changed into a military cap and laid out seven archery butts below the hall. Princes and dukes shot in turn while the eastern and western wings of the music registers were opened and bear, tiger, and other targets were set up.

sentences.zh: 陳賞物於東階，以賚能者；

translations.literal: Reward goods were displayed on the east steps to bestow on the skilled;
translations.idiomatic: Rewards were displayed on the east steps to bestow on those who performed well;

sentences.zh: 設豐爵於西階，以罰否者。

translations.literal: Full goblets were set on the west steps to penalize those who missed.
translations.idiomatic: Full goblets were placed on the west steps to penalize those who missed the mark.

sentences.zh: 並圖其冠冕、儀式、表著、埻埒之位以進。

translations.literal: Together they illustrated the caps and robes, ceremonial forms, display garments, and positions of the mound and butts and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: They also illustrated the caps and robes, ceremonial forms, display garments, and the positions of the mound and butts, and presented the diagrams.

sentences.zh: 帝覽而嘉之，謂宰臣曰：“俟弭兵，當與卿等行之。

translations.literal: The Emperor reviewed them and commended them, saying to the chief ministers: "When hostilities cease, I shall perform this with you.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reviewed them with approval and said to the chief ministers, "When hostilities cease, I shall perform this ceremony with you.

sentences.zh: 凡遊幸池苑，或命宗室、武臣射，每帝射中的，從官再拜奉觴、貢馬為賀。

translations.literal: Whenever touring pools and gardens, or when ordering imperial clansmen and military ministers to shoot, whenever the Emperor hit the target, accompanying officials bowed twice, presented a cup, and offered horses in congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the Emperor toured pools and gardens, or ordered imperial clansmen and military ministers to shoot, each time he hit the target his accompanying officials bowed twice, presented a cup of wine, and offered horses in congratulation.

sentences.zh: 預射官中者，帝為之解，賜襲衣、金帶、散馬，不解則不賜。

translations.literal: Among participating archers who hit, the Emperor removed the arrow for them and granted formal robes, gold belts, and 〈散馬 loose horses as gifts〉; if not removed, nothing was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When a participating archer hit the target, the Emperor removed the arrow for him and granted formal robes, a gold belt, and loose horses as gifts; if the arrow was not removed, nothing was granted.

sentences.zh: 苑中皆有射棚、畫暈的。

translations.literal: The gardens all had archery sheds and painted concentric target rings.
translations.idiomatic: Every garden had archery sheds and painted concentric target rings.

sentences.zh: 射則用招箭班三十人，服緋紫繡衣、帕首，分立左右，以唱中否。

translations.literal: For shooting, an arrow-retrieval corps of thirty men was used, wearing scarlet-purple embroidered robes and headwraps, standing divided left and right to announce hits and misses.
translations.idiomatic: For shooting, a thirty-man arrow-retrieval corps wore scarlet-purple embroidered robes and headwraps, stood divided to left and right, and announced hits and misses.

sentences.zh: 節序賜宴，則宗室、禁軍大校、牧伯、諸司使副皆令習射，遂為定制。

translations.literal: At seasonal-order granted banquets, imperial clansmen, capital guard senior commanders, regional governors, and deputy commissioners of various offices were all ordered to practice archery; it thereby became fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: At seasonal banquets granted by the court, imperial clansmen, senior commanders of the capital guard, regional governors, and deputy commissioners of various offices were all required to practice archery, and this became fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 外國使入朝，亦令帥臣伴，賜射於園苑。

translations.literal: When foreign envoys entered court, they were also ordered to be accompanied by commanding ministers and granted shooting in the garden parks.
translations.idiomatic: When foreign envoys came to court, commanding ministers were also ordered to accompany them and grant them archery in the garden parks.

sentences.zh: 政和宴射儀：皇帝御射殿，侍宴官公服、係鞋，射官窄衣，奏聖躬萬福，再拜升殿。

translations.literal: Zhenghe banquet-archery protocol: The Emperor presided at the Archery Hall; banquet-attending officials wore public dress with tied shoes; archery officials wore narrow robes; they reported the Emperor's myriad blessings; bowed twice and ascended the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe banquet-archery protocol: The Emperor presided at the Archery Hall. Banquet-attending officials wore public dress with tied shoes, archery officials wore narrow robes, they reported the Emperor's myriad blessings, bowed twice, and ascended the hall.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，引射官降，皆執弓矢，謝恩再拜，三公以下在右，射官在左，不射者依坐次分立。

translations.literal: When wine had been served three times, they led the archery officials down; all held bow and arrow, thanked for grace and bowed twice; Three Dukes and below were on the right, archery officials on the left; non-shooters stood separately according to seating order.
translations.idiomatic: After the third round of wine, the archery officials were led down. All held bow and arrow, thanked the Emperor for his grace, and bowed twice. The Three Dukes and those below them stood on the right, the archery officials on the left, and those not shooting stood separately according to seating order.

sentences.zh: 皇帝初射中，舍人讚拜，凡左右祗應臣僚，除內侍外，並階上下再拜。

translations.literal: When the Emperor first hit the target, the usher praised the bow; all left and right attendant officials, except eunuchs, all bowed twice above and below the steps.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor first hit the target, the usher praised the bow. All attendant officials to left and right, except eunuchs, bowed twice both above and below the steps.

sentences.zh: 行門、禁衛、諸班、親從、諸司祗應人並自讚再拜。

translations.literal: Gate guards, imperial guards, various ranks, personal attendants, and attendants of various offices all praised themselves and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Gate guards, imperial guards, various ranks, personal attendants, and attendants of various offices all announced themselves and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 招箭班殿上躬奏訖，跪進碗。

translations.literal: The arrow-retrieval corps, on the hall with body inclined, finished reporting; knelt and presented the bowl.
translations.idiomatic: The arrow-retrieval corps, inclining their bodies on the hall, finished their report, knelt, and presented the bowl.

sentences.zh: 射官先傳弓箭與殿侍，側立。

translations.literal: The archery officials first passed bow and arrow to hall attendants and stood to the side.
translations.idiomatic: The archery officials first passed their bows and arrows to hall attendants and stood to one side.

sentences.zh: 內侍接碗訖，就拜，起，降階再拜。

translations.literal: The eunuch received the bowl; finished; performed obeisance; rose; descended the steps and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch received the bowl, performed obeisance, rose, descended the steps, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 有司進御茶床，天武引進奉馬列射垛前，員僚奏聖躬萬福，東上閣門官詣御前，躬奏班首姓名以下進酒。

translations.literal: The relevant office brought the imperial tea table; Tianwu led forward-presented horses lined before the shooting butt; staff officials reported the Emperor's myriad blessings; the East Upper Gate Command official went before the imperial seat and with body inclined reported the rank leader's name and below presenting wine.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office brought forward the imperial tea table. Tianwu led forward-presented horses to line up before the shooting butt. Staff officials reported the Emperor's myriad blessings, and the East Upper Gate Command official went before the imperial seat and, inclining his body, reported that the rank leader and those below him were presenting wine.

sentences.zh: 班首以下橫行立，讚再拜，班首奉酒進，樂作，飲畢，殿上臣僚再拜。

translations.literal: The rank leader and below stood in horizontal file; the announcer praised the bow; the rank leader held wine and advanced; music performed; when drinking finished, hall officials bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The rank leader and those below him stood in a horizontal line. The announcer praised the bow, the rank leader advanced with wine, music was performed, and when the drinking was finished the officials on the hall bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 舍人讚各賜酒，群官俱再拜，讚各就坐，群官皆立席後，引進司官臨階，宣進奉出，天武奉馬出，樂合，復讚就坐，飲訖，揖，興，諸司收坐物等。

translations.literal: The usher praised granting wine to each; all officials bowed twice together; praised each to take seat; all officials stood behind their mats; Forwarding Office officials came to the steps; announced forwarding-presented items out; Tianwu held horses out; music combined; again praised taking seats; when drinking finished, bowed with clasped hands, rose; various offices collected seating items and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The usher praised the granting of wine to each, and all officials bowed twice together. He praised each to take his seat while all officials stood behind their mats. Forwarding Office officials came to the steps and announced the forwarding of presented items; Tianwu led the horses out; the music combined; the usher again praised taking seats; when drinking was finished they bowed with clasped hands and rose, and the various offices collected the seating items and the like.

sentences.zh: 射官左側臨階，取弓箭侍立。

translations.literal: Archery officials on the left side came to the steps, took bow and arrow and attended standing.
translations.idiomatic: The archery officials on the left side came to the steps, took up their bows and arrows, and stood in attendance.

sentences.zh: 皇帝再射中的或雙中，如上儀。）

translations.literal: If the Emperor again hit the target or hit twice, as above protocol.)
translations.idiomatic: If the Emperor again hit the target or scored a double hit, the same protocol was followed.)

sentences.zh: 進酒臨時取旨，得旨進酒，更不進奉中扁碗。

translations.literal: Presenting wine was at discretion to receive decree; upon receiving decree wine was presented; the 〈中扁碗 hit-mark flat bowl〉 was no longer forward-presented.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting wine awaited the Emperor's decree at the moment; once the decree was received, wine was presented, and the hit-mark flat bowl was no longer forward-presented.

sentences.zh: 及解中，更不賀、不進酒。

translations.literal: When the arrow was removed from the target, there was no longer congratulation or presenting wine.
translations.idiomatic: Once the arrow was removed from the target, there was no further congratulation or presentation of wine.

sentences.zh: 臣僚射中，引降階再拜訖，殿下側立。

translations.literal: When a minister hit the target, he was led down the steps; after bowing twice, stood to the side below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: When a minister hit the target, he was led down the steps; after bowing twice, he stood to one side below the hall.

sentences.zh: 御箭解中，招箭班進碗，如上儀。

translations.literal: When the imperial arrow was removed from the target, the arrow-retrieval corps presented the bowl, as above protocol.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial arrow was removed from the target, the arrow-retrieval corps presented the bowl according to the same protocol as before.

sentences.zh: 舍人再引射，中官當殿揖，躬宣“有敕，賜窄衣、金帶”。

translations.literal: The usher again led shooting; the official who hit, before the hall with clasped-hands bow, with body inclined announced, "There is an edict: granting narrow robe and gold belt."
translations.idiomatic: The usher again led the shooting. The official who had hit bowed with clasped hands before the hall and, inclining his body, announced, "There is an edict: granting a narrow robe and gold belt."

sentences.zh: 跪受，箱過再拜，過殿側服所賜訖，再引當殿再拜，更不謝。）〉

translations.literal: Knelt and received; when the case passed, bowed twice; passed the hall side and donned what was granted; finished; again led before the hall and bowed twice; no further thanks.)
translations.idiomatic: He knelt and received the gift; when the case passed by, he bowed twice; he passed to the side of the hall and donned what had been granted; then he was again led before the hall and bowed twice, without further thanks.)

sentences.zh: 如宣再射，或更賜箭令射，如未退，即就位再拜。

translations.literal: If ordered to shoot again, or further granted arrows and ordered to shoot, if not yet withdrawn, then took position and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: If an edict ordered further shooting, or additional arrows were granted and he was ordered to shoot again, and he had not yet withdrawn, he then took his position and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 如再射中，御箭再解中，賜鞍轡馬如上儀。

translations.literal: If hitting again on second shooting, the imperial arrow was again removed from the target; saddled and bridled horses were granted as above protocol.
translations.idiomatic: If he hit again on the second round of shooting, the imperial arrow was again removed from the target, and saddled and bridled horses were granted according to the same protocol as before.

sentences.zh: 臣僚射中，御箭不解，引降階再拜，立。

translations.literal: When a minister hit the target, the imperial arrow was not removed; he was led down the steps, bowed twice, and stood.
translations.idiomatic: When a minister hit the target but the imperial arrow was not removed, he was led down the steps, bowed twice, and stood.

sentences.zh: 招箭班殿上躬奏訖，下殿，舍人宣“有敕，賜銀碗”。

translations.literal: The arrow-retrieval corps on the hall with body inclined finished reporting; descended the hall; the usher announced, "There is an edict: granting a silver bowl."
translations.idiomatic: The arrow-retrieval corps, inclining their bodies on the hall, finished their report and descended the hall. The usher announced, "There is an edict: granting a silver bowl."

sentences.zh: 跪受執碗並箭，就拜，起，再拜。

translations.literal: Knelt, received, and held the bowl together with the arrow; performed obeisance; rose; bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: He knelt, received the gift, and held the bowl together with the arrow; he performed obeisance, rose, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 如合賜散馬，即同宣賜，宣“有敕，賜銀碗，兼賜散馬若干匹”。

translations.literal: If loose horses were also to be granted, it was announced together: "There is an edict: granting a silver bowl, and also granting a certain number of loose horses."
translations.idiomatic: If loose horses were also to be granted, the announcement was made together: "There is an edict: granting a silver bowl, and also granting a certain number of loose horses."

sentences.zh: 射訖，進御茶床，諸司復陳坐物等，群官各立席後，讚就坐，群官俱坐。

translations.literal: When shooting finished, the imperial tea table was brought forward; various offices again displayed seating items and the like; each official stood behind his mat; praised to take seat; all officials sat.
translations.idiomatic: When the shooting was finished, the imperial tea table was brought forward. The various offices again displayed the seating items and the like, each official stood behind his mat, the announcer praised taking seats, and all officials sat.

sentences.zh: 酒五行，宣示盞、宣勸如儀，皆作樂。

translations.literal: Wine was served five times; presenting cups and urging to drink were announced according to protocol; all with music.
translations.idiomatic: Wine was served five times; presenting cups and urging guests to drink were announced according to protocol, all accompanied by music.

sentences.zh: 宴畢，內侍舉御茶床，三公以下降階再拜，退。

translations.literal: When the banquet finished, eunuchs raised the imperial tea table; Three Dukes and below descended the steps, bowed twice, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the banquet was finished, eunuchs raised the imperial tea table. The Three Dukes and those below them descended the steps, bowed twice, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年二月四日，車駕幸玉津園，皇帝射訖，次命皇太子，次慶王，次恭王，次管軍臣僚等射，如是者三。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the second month of the second year of Qiandao, the imperial carriage visited Jade Ford Garden; the Emperor finished shooting; next ordered the Crown Prince; next the Prince of Qing; next the Prince of Gong; next commanding ministers and others to shoot—thus three rounds.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the second month of the second year of Qiandao, the imperial carriage visited Jade Ford Garden. The Emperor finished shooting, then ordered the Crown Prince, then the Prince of Qing, then the Prince of Gong, then the commanding ministers and others to shoot—thus for three rounds.

sentences.zh: 每射四發，帝前後四中的。

translations.literal: Each shot four arrows; the Emperor hit the target four times before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Each participant shot four arrows; the Emperor hit the target four times in all.

sentences.zh: 鄉飲之禮有三：《周禮》，鄉大夫，三年大比，興賢者、能者，鄉老及鄉大夫帥其吏，與其眾寡，以禮賓之，一也；

translations.literal: The village drinking rite has three forms: In the "Rites of Zhou," the district grandee, in the great triennial comparison, promoted the worthy and the capable; the district elder and district grandee led their clerks and their multitude, lesser and greater, to treat them as guests with ceremony—the first;
translations.idiomatic: The village drinking rite had three forms. In the "Rites of Zhou," the district grandee, at the great triennial comparison, promoted the worthy and the capable; the district elder and district grandee led their clerks and their multitude, greater and lesser, to receive them as guests with ceremony—the first form;

sentences.zh: 黨正，國索鬼神而祭祀，則禮屬民而飲酒於序，以正齒位，二也；

translations.literal: The ward chief, when the state entered 〈國索 mourning for spirits〉 and performed sacrifice, treated the people with ceremony and drank wine at the school hall to set ranks by age—the second;
translations.idiomatic: The ward chief, when the state entered mourning for the spirits and performed sacrifice, treated the people with ceremony and drank wine at the school hall to establish ranks by age—the second form;

sentences.zh: 州長，春秋習射於序，先行鄉飲禮，三也。

translations.literal: The district chief, in spring and autumn practiced archery at the school hall, first performing the village drinking rite—the third.
translations.idiomatic: The district chief, in spring and autumn, practiced archery at the school hall and first performed the village drinking rite—the third form.

sentences.zh: 後世臘蠟百神、春秋習射、序賓飲酒之儀，不行於郡國，唯貢士日設鹿鳴宴，猶古者賓興賢能，行鄉飲之遺禮也。

translations.literal: In later ages the rites of winter wax offering to the hundred spirits, spring and autumn archery practice, and ordering guests to drink wine at the school hall were not performed in the commanderies and states; only on the day of presenting scholars was the Deer Call Banquet set out—still the remnant rite of ancient guest-promotion of the worthy and capable and village drinking.
translations.idiomatic: In later ages the rites of the winter wax offering to the hundred spirits, spring and autumn archery practice, and ordering guests to drink at the school hall were not performed in the commanderies and states. Only on the day of presenting scholars was the Deer Call Banquet held—still a remnant of the ancient rite of guest-promotion of the worthy and capable and of village drinking.

sentences.zh: 然古禮有賓主，僎介，與今之禮不同。

translations.literal: Yet the ancient rite had guest and host, assistant host and secondary guest, differing from today's rite.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the ancient rite distinguished guest and host, assistant host and secondary guest, in ways that differ from today's rite.

sentences.zh: 器以尊俎，與今之器不同。

translations.literal: Vessels used 〈尊俎 zun and zu stands〉, differing from today's vessels.
translations.idiomatic: The vessels used were zun and zu stands, differing from those used today.

sentences.zh: 賓坐於西北，介坐於西南，主人坐東南，僎坐東北，與今之位不同。

translations.literal: The guest sat northwest, the secondary guest southwest, the host southeast, the assistant host northeast, differing from today's positions.
translations.idiomatic: The guest sat in the northwest, the secondary guest in the southwest, the host in the southeast, and the assistant host in the northeast—differing from the seating positions used today.

sentences.zh: 主人獻賓，賓酢主人，主人酬賓，次主人獻介，介酢主人，次主人獻眾賓，與今之儀不同。

translations.literal: The host presented to the guest, the guest returned toast to the host, the host reciprocated to the guest; next the host presented to the secondary guest, the secondary guest returned toast to the host; next the host presented to the multitude of guests, differing from today's protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The host presented wine to the guest, the guest returned a toast to the host, and the host reciprocated to the guest; next the host presented to the secondary guest, who returned a toast to the host; next the host presented to the multitude of guests—differing from today's protocol.

sentences.zh: 今制，州、軍貢士之月，以禮飲酒，且以知州、軍事為主人，學事司所在，以提舉學事為主人，其次本州官入行，上舍生當貢者，與州之群老為眾賓，亦古者序賓、養老之意也。

translations.literal: Under present regulation, in the month when the prefecture or army presents scholars, they drink wine by rite; moreover the military prefect or prefectural governor is host; where the school affairs office is located, the school affairs intendant is host; next local officials of the prefecture enter; upper-hall students who are to be presented, together with the prefecture's group of elders as the multitude of guests—also the intent of ancient ordering guests and honoring the aged.
translations.idiomatic: Under present regulation, in the month when a prefecture or army presents scholars, wine is drunk according to rite. The military prefect or prefectural governor serves as host; where the school affairs office is located, the school affairs intendant serves as host. Next come local officials of the prefecture, upper-hall students who are to be presented, and the prefecture's group of elders as the multitude of guests—reflecting the ancient intent of ordering guests and honoring the aged.

sentences.zh: 是月也，會凡學之士及武士習射，亦古者習射於序之意也。

translations.literal: In that month, all students were assembled and military officers practiced archery—also the intent of ancient practicing archery at the school hall.
translations.idiomatic: In that month all students were assembled and military officers practiced archery—also reflecting the ancient intent of practicing archery at the school hall.

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀所頒禮，惟明州獨存，淳化中會例行之。

translations.literal: The rites promulgated in Tang Zhenguan survived only in Ming Prefecture alone; in Chunhua they were once carried out according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The rites promulgated in the Tang Zhenguan era survived only in Ming Prefecture; during Chunhua they were once carried out according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 政和禮局定飲酒祭降之節，與舉酒作樂器用之屬，並參用辟廱宴貢士儀，其有古樂處，令用古樂。

translations.literal: The Zhenghe Rites Bureau fixed the nodes of wine-drinking and offering descent, together with presenting wine, performing music, and using vessels and the like, all drawing on the 〈辟廱 imperial academy〉 banquet for presented scholars protocol; where ancient music existed, they ordered ancient music to be used.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenghe Rites Bureau fixed the stages of wine-drinking and offering descent, together with presenting wine, performing music, and the use of vessels and the like, all drawing on the imperial academy banquet for presented scholars. Where ancient music was available, they ordered that ancient music be used.

sentences.zh: 既又以河北轉運判官張孝純之言：“《周官》以六藝教士，必射而後行。

translations.literal: Further, on the words of Hebei Transport Vice Commissioner Zhang Xiaochun: "The Offices of Zhou teaches knights with the six arts; one must shoot before proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: Further, on the recommendation of Hebei Transport Vice Commissioner Zhang Xiaochun: "The Offices of Zhou teaches knights through the six arts; archery must come before one may proceed.

sentences.zh: 古者諸侯貢士，天子試諸射宮，請詔諸路州郡，每歲宴貢士於學，因講射禮。

translations.literal: In antiquity when feudal lords presented scholars, the Son of Heaven tested them at the Archery Palace; I request an edict to the various routes, prefectures, and districts that each year at the banquet for presented scholars at the school, the archery rite be expounded.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, when feudal lords presented scholars, the Son of Heaven tested them at the Archery Palace. I request an edict to the various routes, prefectures, and districts that each year, at the banquet for presented scholars at the school, the archery rite be expounded.

sentences.zh: ”於是禮官參定射儀：鄉飲酒前一日，本州於射亭東西序，量地之宜，設提舉學事諸監司、知州、通判、州學教授、應赴鄉飲酒官貢士幕次，本州兵馬教諭備弓矢應用物，設樂。
