translations.literal: "Thereupon the rites officials jointly fixed the archery protocol: On the day before village wine-drinking, the prefecture at the east and west wings of the archery pavilion, according to the fitness of the ground, set tent positions for the school affairs intendant, various supervisory commissioners, prefect, vice prefect, prefectural school professor, officials attending village wine-drinking, and presented scholars; the prefecture military instructor prepared bows, arrows, and requisite items; music was set up.
translations.idiomatic: "Thereupon the rites officials jointly fixed the archery protocol. On the day before the village wine-drinking ceremony, the prefecture, at the east and west wings of the archery pavilion and according to the fitness of the ground, set up tent positions for the school affairs intendant, various supervisory commissioners, the prefect, vice prefect, prefectural school professor, officials attending the village wine-drinking, and presented scholars. The prefecture military instructor prepared bows, arrows, and requisite items, and music was set up.

sentences.zh: 其日初筵，提舉學事、知州軍、通判帥應赴鄉飲酒官貢士詣射亭，執弓矢，揖人射，乘矢若中，則守帖者舉獲唱獲，執算者以算投壺畢，多算勝少算。

translations.literal: At the first mat that day, the school affairs intendant, prefect or army commander, and vice prefect led officials attending village wine-drinking and presented scholars to the archery pavilion; they held bow and arrow, bowed and entered to shoot; if the nocked arrow hit, the target attendants raised the capture and sang capture; the score keepers cast tallies into the pot; when finished, more tallies defeated fewer.
translations.idiomatic: On that day at the first mat, the school affairs intendant, prefect or army commander, and vice prefect led the officials attending the village wine-drinking and the presented scholars to the archery pavilion. They took up bow and arrow, bowed, and entered to shoot. If the nocked arrow hit, the target attendants raised the capture and sang "capture"; the score keepers cast tallies into the pot, and when finished, more tallies defeated fewer.

sentences.zh: 射畢，讚者讚揖，酬酢如儀畢，揖退飲，如鄉飲酒。

translations.literal: When shooting finished, the announcer praised the bow; reciprocal toasts were completed according to protocol; finished; bowed and withdrew to drink, as in village wine-drinking.
translations.idiomatic: When the shooting was finished, the announcer praised the bow. Reciprocal toasts were completed according to protocol; then they bowed, withdrew, and drank as in the village wine-drinking ceremony.

sentences.zh: 紹興七年，郡守仇悆置田以供費。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Shaoxing, the prefect Qiu Yu set aside fields to supply expenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Shaoxing, Prefect Qiu Yu set aside fields to cover the expenses.

sentences.zh: 十三年，比部郎中林保乞修定鄉飲儀制，遍下郡國，於是國子祭酒高閎草具其儀上之，僎介之位，皆與古制不合，諸儒莫解其指意。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Bureau of Review Section Chief Lin Bao requested revision and fixing of village drinking protocol; it was sent down to all commanderies and states; thereupon National University Sacrificial Wine Gao Hong drafted the protocol and submitted it; positions of assistant host and secondary guest all did not accord with the ancient system; various Confucians could not understand its intent.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Bureau of Review Section Chief Lin Bao requested that the village drinking protocol be revised and fixed, and it was sent down to all commanderies and states. Thereupon National University Sacrificial Wine Gao Hong drafted the protocol and submitted it, but the positions of assistant host and secondary guest all failed to accord with the ancient system, and the Confucian scholars could not understand its intent.

sentences.zh: 慶元中，朱熹以《儀禮》改定，知學者皆尊用之，主賓、僎介之位，始有定說。

translations.literal: In the Qingyuan era, Zhu Xi revised it according to the "Ceremonial Rites"; those who knew the rites all honored and used it; positions of host, guest, assistant host, and secondary guest at last had fixed interpretation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingyuan era, Zhu Xi revised the rite according to the "Ceremonial Rites," and those versed in ritual all honored and adopted it. At last there was a fixed interpretation of the positions of host, guest, assistant host, and secondary guest.

sentences.zh: 其主，則州以守、縣以令，位於東南；

translations.literal: As for the host, the prefecture uses the prefect, the district the magistrate, positioned southeast;
translations.idiomatic: The host was the prefect in a prefecture and the magistrate in a district, seated in the southeast;

sentences.zh: 賓，以裏居年高及致仕者，位於西北僎，則州以倅、縣以丞或簿，位東北；

translations.literal: The guest, drawn from those of highest age residing locally and retired officials, positioned northwest; the assistant host, the prefecture uses the vice prefect, the district the assistant magistrate or registrar, positioned northeast;
translations.idiomatic: The guest was drawn from the oldest resident locally or from retired officials and was seated in the northwest; the assistant host was the vice prefect in a prefecture and the assistant magistrate or registrar in a district, seated in the northeast;

sentences.zh: 介，以次長，位西南。

translations.literal: The secondary guest, the next in seniority, positioned southwest.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary guest was the next in seniority and was seated in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 三賓，以賓之次者；

translations.literal: The three guests, those next after the guest;
translations.idiomatic: The three guests were those next in rank after the guest;

sentences.zh: 司正，以眾所推服者；

translations.literal: The protocol director, one whom the multitude respects and submits to;
translations.idiomatic: The protocol director was one whom the assembly respected and deferred to;

sentences.zh: 相及讚，以士之熟於禮儀者。

translations.literal: The assistant and announcer, one among the gentry skilled in ceremonial rites.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant and announcer was a member of the gentry skilled in ceremonial rites.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，主人率賓以下，先釋菜於先聖先師，退各就次，以俟肅賓。

translations.literal: That day at dawn, the host led guest and below first to release vegetable offering before the former sages and former masters; withdrew; each went to station to await formal reception of the guest.
translations.idiomatic: On that day at dawn, the host led the guest and those below him first to perform the vegetable offering before the former sages and former masters. They withdrew, each took his station, and awaited the formal reception of the guest.

sentences.zh: 介與眾賓既入，主人序賓祭酒，再拜，詣罍洗洗觶，至酒尊所酌實觶，授執事者，至賓席前跪以獻賓，賓酬主人，主人酬介，介酬眾賓，賓主以下各就席坐訖。

translations.literal: When the secondary guest and multitude of guests had entered, the host ordered guests and libation wine, bowed twice, went to the wine jar to wash the cup, to the wine vessel place to fill the solid cup, handed it to attendants, came before the guest's mat and knelt to present to the guest; the guest reciprocated to the host, the host reciprocated to the secondary guest, the secondary guest reciprocated to the multitude of guests; guest, host, and below each took seat and sat; finished.
translations.idiomatic: When the secondary guest and the multitude of guests had entered, the host ordered the guests and the libation wine and bowed twice. He went to the wine jar to wash the cup, then to the wine vessel to fill the cup, and handed it to attendants. He came before the guest's mat and knelt to present wine to the guest. The guest reciprocated to the host, the host to the secondary guest, and the secondary guest to the multitude of guests. The guest, host, and those below each took their seats and sat down.

sentences.zh: 酒再行，次沃洗，讚者請司正揚觶致辭，司正復位，主人以下復坐。

translations.literal: When wine had been served twice, next pouring washing; the announcer requested the protocol director to raise the cup and deliver the address; the protocol director returned to position; host and below sat again.
translations.idiomatic: After the second round of wine came the pouring of washing water. The announcer requested the protocol director to raise his cup and deliver the address. The protocol director returned to his position, and the host and those below sat again.

sentences.zh: 主人興，復至阼俯僎從賓介復至西階下立，三賓至西階立，並南向。

translations.literal: The host rose, again came to the host's east side; the assistant followed the guest and secondary guest again to the west steps below to stand; the three guests came to the west steps to stand; all facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The host rose and again came to the host's east side. The assistant followed the guest and secondary guest again to the foot of the west steps to stand, and the three guests came to the west steps to stand, all facing south.

sentences.zh: 主人拜，賓介以下再拜。

translations.literal: The host bowed; guest, secondary guest, and below bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The host bowed, and the guest, secondary guest, and those below bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 賓介與眾賓先自西趨出，主人少立，自東出。

translations.literal: Guest, secondary guest, and multitude of guests first hurried out from the west; the host stood briefly, then came out from the east.
translations.idiomatic: The guest, secondary guest, and multitude of guests first hurried out from the west. The host stood briefly, then came out from the east.

sentences.zh: 賓以下立於庠門外之右，東鄉；

translations.literal: Guest and below stood to the right outside the school gate, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: The guest and those below him stood to the right outside the school gate, facing east;

sentences.zh: 主人立於門外之左，西鄉。

translations.literal: The host stood to the left outside the gate, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood to the left outside the gate, facing west.

sentences.zh: 僎從主人再拜，賓介以下皆再拜，退。

translations.literal: The assistant followed the host and bowed twice; guest, secondary guest, and below all bowed twice; withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant followed the host and bowed twice. The guest, secondary guest, and those below all bowed twice and withdrew.
